Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You beckon to the water, and it reaches for the feet beside it.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
One visible creature within 4 squares, standing in or beside water.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

Choose a visible water square beside the target; measure the pull toward that square. Call a hand of existing water; enough water to fill a bucket must be present. It returns immediately to its source.

Weak
Pull 1 square toward the water.
Standard
Pull 2 squares and Slowed 1.
Strong
Pull 3 squares, apply Slowed 1 and knock prone.
